The Redridge Mountains (also known as the Red Ridge Mountains, the Redridge Range, or simply Redridge) are located east of Elwynn Forest, northeast of Duskwood, and south of the Burning Steppes. Although it may be considered contested, Horde characters have no settlements or NPCs, and it is thus a place they use mostly for passing through to reach Flame Crest or Stonard.
An idyllic region of rushing rivers, towering elms, and rising elevations, the Redridge Mountains are under the protection of the kingdom of Stormwind. On the western bank of Lake Everstill is the Alliance town of Lakeshire, the central hub for this faction's adventurers, offering many services and quests, as well as flight paths. The crossroads known as the Three Corners, located in the southwest corner of the zone, connects the town of Lakeshire with Elwynn, Duskwood and, via the Lakeridge Highway, Stonewatch Keep. The highway itself is quite a dangerous place occupied by gnolls, murlocs, and wild animals.
A force of Blackrock orcs from the Burning Steppes has once secured Stonewatch Keep for the Dark Horde, but are still in control of the northern roads. There are also a few camps located in Redridge — an orc camp in Render's Valley, Shadowhide gnoll camps near the Tower of Ilgalar, and murloc camps near the lake. While the lake's surface appears peaceful enough, murlocs reside beneath the waves, and rumors of sightings of a sea monster persist. There are also raptor nests in the Mountains. In comparison with Westfall, Redridge is still relatively stable.

There are also [[raptor]] nests in the Mountains.''[[Traveler]]'', chapter 3 In comparison with [[Westfall]], Redridge is still relatively stable. ==History== [[File:Lakeshire overview.jpg|thumb|The town of [[Lakeshire]].]] Geographically, the Redridge Mountains form the spine of the continent of [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]], although its many limbs and valleys have come to be known by separate, often ominous names such as '[[Deadwind Pass]]'[[The Last Guardian]] and the '[[Burning Steppes]]'. After the [[War of the Ancients]], the dangerous and destructive [[Demon Soul|Dragon Soul]] created by [[Deathwing]] was hidden beneath the Redridge Mountains. Protected by magical wards and [[Orastrasz]], it would remain hidden for ten thousand years before Deathwing led the [[Dragonmaw clan]] there in dreams and visions.{{Ref WoWCV2|141}} Centuries ago, throughout the [[Eastern Kingdoms]], the disparate human nations flourished, among them the smallest and most isolated of the kingdoms was [[Stormwind (kingdom)|Stormwind]]. Over the years, it found prosperity through the farmsteads that dotted the surrounding fertile region, and as its population grew, small towns sprang up in the nearby regions, notably the Redridge Mountains.{{Ref WoWCV1|159}} Although claimed by the [[human]]s,Quote by [[Morgan]]: "...take back my land... I want what is now called the Burning Steppes, my part of the Redridge Mountains that their fiery overlord destroyed... I'm here to fight for what is rightfully mine." the [[Dark Iron dwarf|dwarven]] [[Dark Iron clan]] founded its own kingdom in the northern reaches, fleeing defeat in the [[War of the Three Hammers]]. Summoning the [[Firelord]] [[Ragnaros]] to aid them, their leader [[Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan|Thaurissan]] inadvertently caused the eruption of a new, immense volcano; [[Blackrock Mountain]]. This not only destroyed his clan's [[Ruins of Thaurissan|new city]] but utterly devastated the ecology of northern Redridge, forever leaving it an ash-choked wasteland. The humans of [[Stormwind (kingdom)|Stormwind]] remained dominant in the unblemished southern ranges. Now a much smaller region, the Redridge Mountains were eventually conquered by the [[Old Horde|Orcish Horde]] in the [[First War]], in which the southern kingdom was forced into exile. The humans eventually returned triumphant and began rebuilding their former holdings. Yet the orcs of the [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] and [[Black Tooth Grin clan]]s would also return, this new "[[Dark Horde]]" plaguing the town of Lakeshire from their former stronghold of Blackrock Mountain. ===World of Warcraft=== {{wow-section}} Eventually, the orcs allied with the wicked human [[warlock]] [[Morganth]] and his [[Shadowhide Gnoll Clan|Shadowhide]] [[gnoll]] lackeys, and seized the eastern half of Redridge, capturing the human castle of [[Stonewatch Keep]] before the events of ''[[World of Warcraft]]''.[[The State of Lakeshire]] Weakened by political turmoil in Stormwind, Lakeshire was left with little military aid to fend off the encroaching orcs until the return of [[Marshal Reginald Windsor|Reginald Windsor]]. Desperate, the people of Redridge sought help from outside sources, recruiting passing [[adventurer]]s to help in the defense of Lakeshire and the liberation of Stonewatch. ===Cataclysm=== {{cata-section}} [[File:lakeshire-bridge.jpg|thumb|[[Everstill Bridge]] only took five years to finish.]] With the guidance of the dragon [[Darkblaze]], the [[Dark Horde]] have also begun invading Redridge sometime after the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]]. An Alliance adventurer deputized by the [[Stormwind Army]] traveled to Redridge to aid the beleaguered Stormwind guards and reform [[Bravo Company]] to combat the threat. During their war with the [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock orcs]], [[Render's Valley]] was blown up, but the Dark Horde has been driven back to the [[Burning Steppes]]. Stonewatch Keep has also been reclaimed. Stormwind also increased Redridge's security by constructing [[Tower Watch]] on the [[Three Corners]] and stationing a garrison of [[Redridge Garrison Watchman|Redridge Watchmen]] there. ===Traveler=== {{novel-section}} At some point in the past, [[Greydon Thorne]] hid three crystal shards from the [[Diamond Blade]] that held the essence of a [[naaru]] that was a key do the defense of Azeroth against the [[Darkstorm]]. [[Gazlowe]], [[Charnas]], and [[Gimble Sprysprocket]] transported [[Makasa Flintwill]] and her friends to the area on the ''[[Cloudkicker]]''. Due to the political situation, while Makasa and her group were in Lakeshire and surrounding areas looking for the crystal shards, the [[Horde]] [[zeppelin]] and the [[goblin]]s stayed hidden somewhere in the northern mountains. The first shard was in Lakeshire, in the backyard of the [[Glade]]s' house, the second one was in a cave northeast of the village that has been guarded by a [[blue drake]] named [[Telagos]] for several years, and the last one was in a mine shaft of the [[Lake Everstill|Lakeshire quarry]]. Later, [[Murky (Traveler)|Murky]] also secured the help from the [[Everstill murlocs]], taking them aboard the ''Cloudkicker'' to the [[Blasted Lands]].''[[Traveler: The Shining Blade]]'' ===Shadowlands=== {{sl-section}} During [[Death Rising]], the Redridge Mountains came under attack from the [[Scourge]]. To fight against the undead, troops of the [[Stormwind Army]] and the [[Argent Crusade]] were mobilized in order to protect the region and its inhabitants. ==Geography== [[File:Redridge Highway.jpg|thumb|[[Redridge Pass]]]] [[File:Redridge Canyons.jpg|thumb|[[Redridge Canyons]]]] The Redridge Mountains contain no dungeons, raid dungeons, or battlegrounds. The micro dungeon [[Stonewatch]] can be found in this zone. The Redridge Range stretches from the zone of the Redridge Mountains to the zone of [[Deadwind Pass]]. ===Redridge Range=== The '''Redridge Range'''''[[The Last Guardian]]'', pg. 2 is a mountain range in the southern sub-continent of [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]]. It reaches from the [[Deadwind Pass]] in the south to what's now called the [[Searing Gorge]] in the north. Two hundred years before the opening of the [[Dark Portal]], the northern reaches of the range were obliterated by the summoning of [[Ragnaros|Firelord Ragnaros]] and the creation of [[Blackrock Mountain]]. ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:WorldMap-Redridge.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Redridge Mountains.]] [[File:WorldMap-Redridge-old.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Redridge Mountains prior to ''[[World of Warcraft: Cataclysm|Cataclysm]]''.]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Alther's Mill]] *[[Camp Everstill]] *[[Galardell Valley]] *[[Keeshan's Post]] *[[Lake Everstill]] *[[Lakeridge Highway]] *[[Lakeshire]] **[[Lakeshire Inn]] **[[Lakeshire Town Hall]] *[[Redridge Canyons]] *[[Redridge Pass]] *[[Render's Camp]] **[[Render's Rock]] *[[Render's Valley]] *[[Rethban Caverns]] *[[Shalewind Canyon]] *[[Stonewatch]] **[[Stonewatch Keep]] **[[Stonewatch Tower]] *[[Stonewatch Falls]] *[[Three Corners]] **[[Tower Watch]] *[[Tower of Ilgalar]] *[[Yowler's Den]] |- || ---- ;[[Undisplayed location]]s *[[Everstill Bridge]] *[[Nazferiti river]] |- || ---- ;{{RPG-inline}} [[Warcraft RPG]] *[[Searing Peak]] |} [http://wow.gamepressure.com/map.asp?ID=18 Topographic map of Redridge Mountains] {{clear|left}} ===Travel hubs=== [[File:Shalewind Canyon from Render's Valley.jpg|thumb|[[Shalewind Canyon]]]] [[File:Keeshan's Post.jpg|thumb|[[Keeshan's Post]]]] ;{{Alliance}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Lakeshire]] *[[Stormwind]], [[Elwynn Forest]] *[[Eastvale Logging Camp]], [[Elwynn Forest]] *[[Sentinel Hill]], [[Westfall]] *[[Camp Everstill]], Redridge Mountains *[[Darkshire]], [[Duskwood]] *[[Morgan's Vigil]], [[Burning Steppes]] *[[The Harborage]], [[Swamp of Sorrows]] ;{{Alliance}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Camp Everstill]] *[[Lakeshire]], Redridge Mountains *[[Shalewind Canyon]], Redridge Mountains ;{{Alliance}} [[Flight path]]s from [[Shalewind Canyon]] *[[Camp Everstill]], Redridge Mountains *[[Bogpaddle]], [[Swamp of Sorrows]] ===Adjacent regions=== {| class="darktable" |- ! AHHHHHHHHH!!!]] has been completed. ==Notable characters== {{main|Redridge Mountains NPCs}} The Redridge Mountains are home to several humans of note, the great bulk of which reside in Lakeshire. At the fallen bridge [[Marshal Marris]] sends promising young humans to eradicate the clusters of Shadowhide gnolls and Blackrock orcs who have taken a chokehold on the land. He is assisted in his efforts by [[Verner Osgood]], who also seeks to rid Redridge of the vile gnolls. And at the Lakeshire Town Hall, the aging [[Magistrate Solomon]] recruits adventurers to seek help from Stormwind's other settlements like Stormwind City, Sentinel Hill, and Darkshire. ==Quests== {{main|Redridge Mountains storyline}} ==Resources== *[[Cloth]] **[[Linen Cloth]] **[[Wool Cloth]] **[[Silk Cloth]] *[[Herb]]s **[[Earthroot]] **[[Mageroyal]] **[[Swiftthistle]] **[[Briarthorn]] **[[Bruiseweed]] *[[Leather]] **[[Light Leather]] **[[Medium Leather]] **[[Black Whelp Scale]] (Skinning level 17-25 [[Black whelp|whelps]]) *[[Ore]] **[[Copper Vein]] **[[Tin Vein]] **[[Silver Vein]] ==Dig sites== {{Digsite Map|zone=Redridge Mountains|digsites= {{Digsite Note|39|68|1|Lakeridge Highway Fossil Bank}} }} Redridge Mountains has one [[dig site]]: # [[Lakeridge Highway]]; contains [[Fossil Archaeology Fragment]]s. ==Battle pets== *[[Roach]] *[[Fossilized Hatchling]] - [[Archaeology]] only *[[Rabbit]] *[[Mountain Cottontail]] *[[Pterrordax Hatchling]] - [[Archaeology]] only *[[Fledgling Buzzard]] *[[Chicken]] *[[Flipsy]] {{Untameable}} *[[Dipsy]] {{Untameable}} *[[Flufftail]] {{Untameable}} ==Wild creatures== *{{RaceIcon|Boar}} [[Boar]]s *{{RaceIcon|CarrionBird}} [[Carrion bird]]s *{{RaceIcon|WhelpBlack}} [[Black whelp]]s *{{RaceIcon|Gnoll}} [[Gnoll]]s *{{RaceIcon|Murloc|Male}} [[Murloc]]s *{{RaceIcon|Orc|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Orc|Female}} [[Orc]]s *{{RaceIcon|Tarantula}} [[Tarantula]]s *{{RaceIcon|Threshadon}} [[Threshadon]]s *{{RaceIcon|MountainGiant}} [[Giant]]s (only one though, the rare mob [[Boulderheart]]) *{{RaceIcon|Eel}} [[Freshwater Eel]]s *{{RaceIcon|Wolf}} [[Wolf|Wolves]] (could be seen near Lakeshire when [[Ben Howell]] perished) *{{RaceIcon|Raptor}} [[Raptor]]s (in lore) ==In the RPG== {{RPG-section}} The '''Redridge Mountains''' is a lovely area surrounded by some troubled spots, but so far has been untainted by the [[Burning Legion]] or the [[Scourge]].''[[Lands of Conflict]]'', pg. 50 The [[Burning Steppes]] to the north were formerly part of the Redridge Mountains''[[Lands of Conflict]]'', pg. 43 as well was the area of [[Lethlor Ravine]] in the [[Badlands]], which was once beautiful and verdant. Both were transformed after the summoning of [[Ragnaros]] destroyed the northern part of the mountains.''[[Lands of Conflict]]'', pg. 68 Supplying the [[Alliance]] with timber, [[fish]] and crops, the Redridge Mountains is also a vacation spot for many residents of [[Stormwind City|Stormwind]]. The tranquil woods, rivers, and lakes make it a sought-after retirement area for veterans with fish to catch and tales to tell. Only a handful of dangers trouble it: the usual monsters of the woods and the small matter of the Alliance keep overtaken by [[orc]]s. The [[Stormwind (kingdom)|Stormwind]] [[Stormwind Army|army]] maintains a token presence here and handles Redridge's few crime problems. There is no better place in [[Azeroth]] to enjoy a pint. To summarize, Redridge is a haven in the midst of a troubled continent.''[[Lands of Conflict]]'', pg. 51 ===History=== Redridge was once a larger stretch of mountains in which the [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Iron dwarves]] established a colony in the northern reaches called [[Ruins of Thaurissan|Thaurisan]] after their exile from [[Ironforge]]. Their mad [[thane]] [[Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan|Thaurisan]] befouled the region when he summoned [[Ragnaros]]. Half the mountain range melted into the Burning Steppes, but the rest remained pristine. These mountains and foothills were used as thoroughfares in the many wars in the past fifty years, but they somehow remained untouched while the surrounding regions suffered. Now it is the last true area wholly under Alliance influence in [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]], and it sometimes struggles to remain so.''[[Lands of Conflict]]'', pg. 51 - 52 ===Geography=== While the ravaged mountains of the [[Burning Steppes]] border it on the north and the deadly [[Swamp of Sorrows]] and [[Deadwind Pass]] border it on the south, the Redridge Mountains more reflects the beautiful [[Elwynn Forest]] to the west. Redridge matches Elwynn's climate, being warm and temperate with just the right amount of rain. The higher altitude and closer proximity to the mountains make it a bit cooler than Elwynn, but no less pleasant. Several elms and pines make up the forests in this region, providing a traveler much needed relief from the sun if he is coming from far away lands, but also giving monsters and orcs good places to hide. [[River]]s snake through the area, most of them emptying into the massive [[Lake Everstill]]. Although a peaceful Alliance region, the mountains remain dangerous at times, with [[tarantula]]s in the east and [[orc]]s in the north, and the usual [[gnoll]]s or [[Wolf|wolves]] prowling the forests. ==Film universe== {{movie-section}} The Redridge Mountains are depicted close to their ''[[World of Warcraft]]'' incarnation. [[Stonewatch Keep#Film universe|Stonewatch Keep]] is shown falling to the {{Fu|Horde}}. ==Notes== *Some of the trees here are oaks.''[[Traveler: The Shining Blade]]'', chapter 29 *It's recommended that one wears a helmet when in the Redridge Mountains, as buzzards view humanoid hair as excellent nesting material.[[Fledgling Buzzard]] *Redridge had one of the game's highest level-gaps between zones at its border with the [[Burning Steppes]], which is a 30 level jump from 20 to 50. Players were instead directed to [[Duskwood]] (to the southwest) after completing all the quests here.
